source.description: Approved handmade raster 3x2 pencil-process contact sheet, cropped only after full-sheet review.
source.notes: One centered garden spider on a small radial web; no lettering or embedded UI.

process_strategy: Six cumulative panels preserve one spider and web: scaffold, web, body, legs, markings, then only graphite value and restrained color.

final_elements.name: radial garden web
final_elements.description: One oval radial web with eight spoke routes and a loose outer spiral.

final_elements.name: garden spider
final_elements.description: One small centered oval-bodied spider with eight bent legs.

final_elements.name: spider head and abdomen contour
final_elements.description: The refined small head and oval abdomen on the reserved central body.

final_elements.name: leaf anchor
final_elements.description: One small leaf behind the lower web edge, reserved before its contour is drawn.

final_elements.name: spider markings and color
final_elements.description: A simple pale abdomen cross, graphite texture, muted rust body, and cool-gray shadow.

final_elements.name: graphite value and restrained color
final_elements.description: Pencil texture and light muted color applied only to the established spider, leaf, and shadow.

overlap_reservations.background_lines_stop_before: Web spokes stop at the pale oval spider reserve rather than crossing keeper lines through the body.
Lower web spiral leaves the small leaf footprint open.

frames.visible_job: Place the oval web envelope, eight spoke routes, spider body reserve, leaf reserve, and shadow footprint in pale graphite.
Connect the established spokes with a loose spiral and draw the one reserved leaf anchor.
Draw the same small head and oval abdomen on the central reserve.
Add exactly eight bent legs and the established simple abdomen cross.
Add graphite texture, muted rust pencil color, cool-gray leaf and shadow tint only to established forms.

final_step.visible_job: Only clarify established keeper contours, graphite texture, restrained color, and shadow.

rejection_checks: Reject any panel that changes the spider pose, leg count, web spokes, or leaf position.
Reject a final that introduces legs, web threads, markings, or color absent in an earlier frame.
Reject clean vector-like lines, unteachable detail, or a non-cumulative redraw.
